{"role_hierarchy": {"owner": ["manager", "member"], "manager": ["member"]},
 "extra_transitions": [],
 "cross_entity_invariants": [
  {"vars": ["ctx.is_owner", "tr.role"], "rule": "Only the project owner (or a member with owner role) can initiate an ownership transfer; tr.role must be owner for a transfer request to be valid."},
  {"vars": ["ctx.memberships", "ctx.is_manager"], "rule": "ctx.is_manager is true only if the user holds a manager-or-higher membership in the project."},
  {"vars": ["Project.owner", "ctx.ownerships"], "rule": "Project.owner of a project listed in ctx.ownerships equals the current user."},
  {"vars": ["Check.project", "project.ping_key"], "rule": "A check resolved via ping_key/slug lookup must belong to the project that owns that ping_key."},
  {"vars": ["Channel.project", "channel.email_verified"], "rule": "Email channel verification (email_verified=true) only applies to a channel whose verification token matches its Channel.id."},
  {"vars": ["project.api_key", "ctx.key_created"], "rule": "When ctx.key_created is true, project.api_key holds the newly generated key and the old key is invalidated (ctx.key_revoked false)."}
 ],
 "auth_chains": [
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/login/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "login form establishes user session"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/login/two_factor/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "checks completed first-factor authentication before 2FA step"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/login/two_factor/totp/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "completes TOTP verification and fully authenticates session"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/logout/", "direction": "clear", "rationale": "destroys session"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/check_token/<str:username>/<str:token>/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "validates login-link token and signs user in"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/login_link_sent/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "part of login-link flow that issues authentication token"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/signup/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "creates account and authenticated session"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/set_password/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "requires an authenticated/verified session to set password"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/profile/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "shows per-user data, requires login"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/close/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "account closure requires confirmation from logged-in user"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/change_email/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "requires logged-in user to initiate email change"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/change_email/<str:signed_payload>/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "signed payload verifies and completes email change (authn state)"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/two_factor/webauthn/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "manages WebAuthn credentials of the authenticated user (Credential.user)"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/two_factor/totp/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "manages TOTP for the logged-in user"},
  {"endpoint": "GET projects/<uuid:code>/settings/", "direction": "require", "rationale": "checks ctx.memberships/is_owner/is_manager before exposing API keys"},
  {"endpoint": "GET accounts/unsubscribe_reports/<str:signed_username>/", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "TimestampSigner with 'reports' salt authenticates the unsubscribe action"}
 ]}
